lead.question: 恩得利农场“闹鬼”多年，考克斯兄弟为何甘愿保守秘密五十多年？
lead.warmup: 在英格兰乡村的恩得利农场，村民们世代相传着一个幽灵的故事：夜里有“鬼”帮忙割干草、打扫牛棚。农场主乔和鲍勃·考克斯雇了好几拨农工，却没有人愿意久留。直到一场葬礼，兄弟俩才揭开尘封半个世纪的家族秘密。故事既有悬疑，也藏着亲情的重量，读来令人唏嘘。
goals: 读懂“幽灵”背后的家族秘密，理清 Eric 与 Joe、Bob 的兄弟关系。
掌握 haunt、suspect、desert、recluse 等本课关键词的用法。
学会用过去完成时（had done / had been done）交代更早发生的背景。
识别并运用 that / who 引导的定语从句，读懂课文长句。
lead.summary: 课文讲述恩得利农场“闹鬼”的真相。多年来，村民都相信农场有一个尽责的幽灵：夜里干草被切好，牛棚被打扫干净。其实那并不是鬼，而是考克斯家被认为早已死在战场上的长子埃里克。他因逃离军队、害怕当局，被父亲藏在家中，白天睡觉、夜里干活。父亲与两个弟弟为他保守秘密五十余年，直到他去世，真相才在葬礼后公开。
lead.tips: haunt 表“闹鬼”时多用被动：The farm was haunted；而 hunt 是“打猎”，别把 haunted 写成 hunted。

questions.q: Why did the two brothers keep the secret?
questions.zh: 兄弟俩为什么要保守这个秘密？
questions.a: Because their brother Eric had deserted the army and feared the authorities. Their father had hidden him and told everybody that he had been killed in action; after their father died, Joe and Bob thought it their duty to keep Eric in hiding and protect him.
questions.aZh: 因为他们的哥哥埃里克是逃兵，害怕当局。父亲当年把他藏起来，还对外谎称他阵亡；父亲去世后，乔和鲍勃觉得有责任继续把埃里克藏起来保护他。
questions.hint: 答案见课文后半部分：'Fearing the authorities, Eric remained in hiding after the war as well.' 及 'they thought it their duty to keep Eric in hiding'。

questions.q: What made the farmhands believe that a ghost was doing the work?
questions.zh: 是什么让农工们相信有“鬼”在帮农场干活？
questions.a: They always woke up to find that work had been done overnight: hay had been cut and cowsheds had been cleaned.
questions.aZh: 他们每天醒来都发现活已在夜里干完——干草切好了，牛棚也打扫干净了。
questions.hint: 答案见 'they always woke up to find that work had been done overnight...'。

questions.q: Who was the 'ghost' of Endley Farm, and when was he supposed to have died?
questions.zh: 恩得利农场的“幽灵”究竟是谁？人们以为他何时去世？
questions.a: He was none other than Eric Cox, the eldest of the three brothers, who was supposed to have died as a young man.
questions.aZh: 他不是别人，正是三兄弟中的长子埃里克·考克斯；人们以为他年轻时就已经死了。
questions.hint: 答案见 'the "ghost" was none other than Eric Cox, a third brother who was supposed to have died as a young man.'。

questions.q: Why did Eric return to the farm and stay in hiding?
questions.zh: 埃里克为什么逃回农场并一直躲藏？
questions.a: He hated army life and decided to desert his regiment. When he learnt that he would be sent abroad, he returned to the farm and his father hid him; fearing the authorities, he remained in hiding even after the war.
questions.aZh: 他厌恶军旅生活，逃离了所在部队；得知将被派往国外后逃回农场，父亲把他藏了起来；战后因害怕当局又继续躲藏。
questions.hint: 答案见 'As he hated army life, he decided to desert his regiment.' 与 'Fearing the authorities, Eric remained in hiding after the war as well.'。

questions.q: Do you think the brothers were right to keep the secret for so long? Why?
questions.zh: 你认为兄弟俩保守这个秘密这么久是否值得？为什么？
questions.a: Open answer. For example: they acted out of family loyalty and the wish to protect Eric, but the price was that Eric lived as a recluse for over fifty years, cut off from the outside world and quite unaware that he had become the ghost of Endley. Honesty might have given him a freer and happier life.
questions.aZh: 开放性答案。例如：他们出于亲情和对哥哥的保护，但代价是埃里克像隐士一样与世隔绝五十多年，失去自由，还浑然不知自己已成了恩得利的“鬼”。当年若坦诚面对，他或许能过得更自由、更像个人。
questions.hint: 结合课文结尾 'Eric had lived as a recluse... quite unaware of the fact that he had become the ghost of Endley' 谈个人看法。

exercises.q: 汉译英：多年来，村民们一直认为恩得利农场在闹鬼。
exercises.a: For years, villagers believed that Endley Farm was haunted.

exercises.q: 改错：For years, villagers believed that Endley Farm was hunting.
exercises.a: hunting → haunted（应为‘闹鬼’，而非‘打猎’）。

exercises.q: 用所给词的适当形式填空：As he hated army life, he decided ________ (desert) his regiment.
句型转换（把画线句改为过去完成时被动）：He woke up and found that someone had done the work overnight.
exercises.a: He woke up to find that the work had been done overnight.

exercises.q: 合并句子（用非限制性定语从句）：The 'ghost' was Eric Cox. He was supposed to have died as a young man.
exercises.a: The 'ghost' was Eric Cox, who was supposed to have died as a young man.
exercises.note: who 引导非限制性定语从句。

exercises.q: 汉译英：谁也没想到农场里还有一个从未露面的人。
exercises.a: No one suspected that there might be someone else on the farm who had never been seen.
exercises.note: suspect 后接 that 从句。

exercises.q: 汉译英：二战期间他被迫参军；战后因害怕当局，他多年来一直过着隐士般的生活。
exercises.a: During the Second World War he was obliged to join the army; after the war, fearing the authorities, he had lived as a recluse for years.
exercises.note: be obliged to do；分词状语。

quiz.q: 村民们为什么相信恩得利农场“闹鬼”？
options: Work was always found done overnight.
Strange lights appeared in the cowshed every night.
The farmhouse was left empty and silent all day long.
The brothers often heard someone shouting in the fields.
quiz.note: 农工醒来发现活已在夜里干完。

quiz.q: 那个声称见过“鬼”的农工究竟看到了什么？
options: A stranger walking into the farmhouse at midnight.
An old man feeding the cows in the cowshed.
A figure cutting corn in the moonlight.
A soldier hiding behind the haystack.
quiz.note: 他彻夜未眠，说见人影月光下收割。

options: A farmhand who had worked on the farm for many years.
Eric Cox, the eldest brother, who was thought to have died long before.
The brothers' father, who had died during the Second World War.
A soldier who had once escaped from the army.
quiz.note: none other than Eric Cox，家长子。

quiz.q: 埃里克当年为什么躲进农场不再露面？
options: He wanted to help his brothers with the farm work.
He was seriously ill and could not go out of doors.
He was angry with his father and hid himself away.
He had deserted the army and feared the authorities.
quiz.note: 逃兵，害怕当局，一直藏身。

quiz.q: 埃里克为什么会被误认成“幽灵”？
options: He slept by day and worked at night, unaware that he had become a ghost.
He wrapped himself in a white sheet and walked round the farm.
He made strange noises to frighten the farmhands away.
He never showed himself even to his own brothers.
quiz.note: 白天睡夜里干，浑然不知自己是‘鬼’。

quiz.q: 这个秘密最终为什么无法再保守下去？
options: Because the villagers forced the brothers to tell the truth.
Because the police discovered Eric hiding on the farm.
Because Eric died and his brothers could no longer keep the secret.
Because Eric's wife told everyone the story.
quiz.note: Eric 去世，兄弟俩无法再隐瞒。
